faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Afghan Hound?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 50-60 lb (23-27 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Hip dysplasia; Allergies; Hypothyroidism. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.
